is_anopheles.evidence: The paper studies Anopheles gambiae complex and Anopheles funestus.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports Vgsc L1014F and L1014S (page 14).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper uses previously published data (Moyes et al. 2019) for its modelling. It does not report primary genotype counts or frequencies for new populations; it only uses aggregated data for model training.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses data from field-collected mosquitoes across Africa.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a modelling study that re-analyses previously published datasets (Moyes et al. 2019, Hancock et al. 2018) to generate predictive maps.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study uses geolocated data points across Africa.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper explicitly states it uses a database of susceptibility tests from Moyes et al. 2019 and Hancock et al. 2018.

supplement.evidence: The paper is a modelling study and does not contain primary field data.

assessment.summary: This is a modelling study that uses previously published insecticide resistance bioassay and Vgsc genotype data to map resistance trends across Africa. It is not a primary empirical study reporting new field-collected genotype data.
exclusion_reasons: Not a primary empirical study (it is a modelling/meta-analysis paper)
Does not report primary extractable genotype data (uses previously published datasets)
